name: AI Champdany Industries Limited
about: AI Champdany Industries Limited manufactures and trades in jute products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Jute/Jute Diversified Products and Services, and Flax Products. The company offers hessian fabrics/burlap, hessian jute bags food/regular grades, jute tapes, jute yarns, jute soil saver/erosion control blankets, jute leno scrim cloths, hessian rolls/sheets, carpet backing cloths, jute ropes, and hessian plasterised scrims. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1873 and is based in Kolkata, India.
